# Rive runtime

Unmodified `@rive-app/canvas` 2.49.4 JavaScript and WASM from the npm registry. Package tarball SHA1: d46e7439ec06e806dedad5098bc077a3ada3ede9. License: MIT (package metadata).

Pinned only in this prototype. The existing local preview uses 2.32.0, which produced detached ArrayBuffer errors during extended mesh playback. A trial local patch did not resolve it and is not included. Production runtime and package dependencies are unchanged.
